children: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates:

The markets return to the street for the Sensex weekly expiry session after making some much needed recovery on Wednesday after languishing towards the 23,000 mark. After a steady 100 point gain, the 50-stock index and the broader market at large will hope to sustain the momentum in the expiry session.

However, there are two key factors that could spoil the sport. At first, the markets will react to the development Eccles Building, that saw the US Fed under Kevin Warsh hiked interest rate for the first time since 2023 by 25 basis points to a target range of 3.75% to 4%.

This saw the Dow Jones nosedive, closing with a 600 point fall. Meanwhile, the US dollar has appreciated, with the Dollar Index rising to the 100 mark. This could put some downward pressure on the Indian Rupee, so that remains another focus.
Furthermore, the conflict in West Asia, and it's now ever expanding scope puts crude under pressure, keeping the benchmark Brent above $105 mark.

And as we go into this mid week session, some of the stocks to watch out for the day are banking stocks, Fintech stocks, IT stock, Fortis Healthcare, Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Kalpataru Projects and more and more.

title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Nifty to react to US Fed rate cut; Rupee in focus
